The '''JR-4 swoop''' was a heavy swoop bike manufactured by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] at the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Originally marketed as a single-person airspeeder, it soon gained the nickname "swoop" due to its maneuverability at high altitudes.

It was considered as one of the earliest swoop bikes ever made and its production run lasted for several centuries, until it was discontinued some 100 years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

The [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop bike]], nicknamed Freeco bike, was based on the JR-4 model.<ref name="DBFb">{{DB|vehicle|freecobike|Freeco bike (CK-6 swoop)|nobackup=1}}</ref>
